clips.name: SnowboardIdle
clips.description: Quiet binding stance with breathing and a small look around

clips.name: SnowboardCruise
clips.description: Balanced riding with soft upper-body absorption

clips.name: SnowboardTuck
clips.description: Low aerodynamic crouch, arms forward and tucked

clips.name: SnowboardOllie
clips.description: Compress, extend and gather; gameplay owns jump height

clips.name: SnowboardLanding
clips.description: Impact compression, antenna follow-through and recovery

clips.name: SnowboardTailgrab
clips.description: Reach toward rear binding with opposite arm balancing

clips.name: SnowboardNosegrab
clips.description: Reach toward front binding with opposite arm balancing

clips.name: SnowboardFrontflip
clips.description: Gather then open; gameplay owns the full rotation

clips.name: SnowboardWipeout
clips.description: Balance loss, asymmetric brace, impact compression and damped settling

clips.name: SnowboardRemount
clips.description: Anticipation, compact airborne remount and planted finish

clips.name: Run
clips.description: Alternating short plush strides with opposed arm swing
